blocking_findings.detail: For every R35 candidate family/revision, import_historical_identity_surface derives synthetic origin/evidence hashes instead of importing the actual values available in v35.

The migration maps families 1-141 to families 142-282, while creating R0002 revisions inside families 142-282. It neither preserves the actual R35 family origin nor allocates a genuinely new family after origin change.
All current v36 origin keys differ from the actual v35 origin keys, but the same family IDs 142-282 are retained and assigned R0002.
R36 parentage and status events are inserted, but delivered code contains no insertion into p3_release_change_ledger.
The pilot index selects 40 candidates, while packet generation is separately truncated by --limit and produces only 11 packets/drafts.
Response variant, split, hierarchy, derived index, exact-only, and precedence-overlap still use unrelated proxy predicates; a global used set suppresses allowed overlap.
Only 11 candidates run through the full packet evidence builder; the other 130 hashes are accepted by length-only reporting.
A redirect object stripped to endpoint IDs passes the inherited schema and shipped v36 validator after hash recomputation.
run_case marks any exception as EXPECTED_FAIL. Incomplete promotion still fails at missing variant assignment; stale-hash changes only top-level hashes.
Fixtures run in the main p3a_v27_shadow schema and persist fixture-release canonical/adjudication rows; no dedicated schema/database teardown is implemented.
The verifier accepts hash length, CSV PASS cells, pilot row counts, and fixture labels rather than reconstructing history, all hashes, pilot evidence, or named fixture invariants.
